---
title: "Reference"
---

## Commands

| Command | Contract |
|---|---|
| `uv sync --frozen` | Synchronize exactly from `uv.lock`. |
| `uv run reproduce --check` | Reproduce twice and fail if deterministic outputs differ. |
| `uv run pytest` | Verify known analysis behavior. |
| `uv run pre-commit run --all-files` | Run all local quality and documentation gates. |
| `quarto render docs` | Render the Divio documentation site. |

## Configuration

`config/default.toml` accepts `input_path`, non-negative `minimum_value`, and `category`. The category `all` disables category filtering.

## Output

`AnalysisResult` contains category, count, total, average, input SHA-256, and configuration SHA-256.
